semantic_rules: Every evidence record has period, scale, method, source and non-empty limitations.
SHAP and partial-effect are model attribution or response summaries, not causal effects.
Matrix categories are synthesis-based screening/review categories, not future risk probabilities.
Reader-facing evidence is generated from canonical feature codes and stable status codes; raw source strings remain audit-only.
No future risk probability is produced.
Cluster evidence is not downscaled to spatial units.
